workspace.description: The workspace whose setup it is, by the slug list_workspaces answered; leave it out where the member belongs to one workspace alone.

repository.description: The repository whose script to save, as owner/name; leave it out to save the workspace's install script.

kind.description: Which of the repository's scripts to save: setup, which runs once in each new agent sandbox of it after its checkout, or archive, which runs once in each just before it is deleted for good as its agent is archived; setup where left out.

script.description: The whole script, which replaces the one that stood; an empty one removes it.
